user.title: Set up InfinAssistant
user.description: Enter a device identifier for your PineTime watch (e.g., MAC address or friendly name). After setup, you'll receive a webhook URL and signing key to configure in your Android bridge app.

init.title: InfinAssistant Settings

data_description.rate_limit: Maximum webhook requests per minute per device (30–120). Default: 60.
data_description.replay_window: Maximum allowed age of a signed request in seconds (10–300). Default: 30.
data_description.rotate_key: Check this box and save to generate a new HMAC signing key. The old key will remain valid for 60 minutes.

rotate_key.title: Confirm Key Rotation
rotate_key.description:
Generating a new HMAC signing key will invalidate the current key after a 60-minute grace period.

Make sure your bridge app is ready to receive the new key before confirming.

rotate_key_done.title: New Signing Key Generated
rotate_key_done.description:
Your new HMAC signing key has been generated.

🔑 **New secret (base64):** `{new_secret}`

📷 **QR Payload (scan with bridge app):**
```
{qr_payload}
```

The old key will continue to be accepted for **{grace_minutes} minutes**. Update your bridge app before then.
